title: Commit 3e56595: Release Tabby seed 42 with max(H, 128) inference
note: Changed README, config.json and model.safetensors (new LFS object, about 587 MB). Message: merges the seed-42 epoch-14 prompt with a 175,000-step backbone and sets a minimum forecast span of 128. A later commit the same day corrects the stated pretraining duration to 165,000 steps.

title: TabbyTSFM directory in huawei-noah/trustworthyAI
note: Model code, pretraining and prompt post-training entry points, and evaluation scripts for GIFT-Eval, TIME, UCR and TSB-AD. No checkpoints bundled. The directory page states no licence for the code and reports no benchmark values. Forecast example passes only start and target, no covariates. No release date on the page.

title: sktime issue 11683: Tabby forecasting foundation model
note: Third-party integration request, closed as completed 2026-11-07 through PR 11691. Describes the model as loading via transformers with trust_remote_code, per-series forecasting, 99 quantiles, and notes the CC BY-NC 4.0 licence. The planned estimator ignores exogenous inputs. No benchmark rerun.

title: Tabby: An Open Pretraining Recipe for Time Series Foundation Models (abstract)
note: Tech report by Huawei Noah's Ark authors; v1 2026-09-12, v2 2026-09-29. Encoder-only patch Transformer, 145M parameters, context up to 8,192 points. Says zero-shot forecasting is competitive on GIFT-Eval and TIME; no numbers in the abstract. Pretrained on GIFT-Eval-Pretrain+, BLAST and synthetic data. Code and model said to be open. Covariates not mentioned.

title: Tabby report, full text v2 (main body)
note: Main comparison numbers are in a figure only; text says Tabby is ahead of Sundial, TimesFM 2.5 and Chronos-Bolt on GIFT-Eval and TIME. Chronos-2 not among the compared models in the text read. Tabby-Small ablation (97 GIFT-Eval entries): MASE 0.7368, CRPS 0.5038. Limitations: channel-independent, no external covariates. No electricity-load result.

title: Tabby report, full text v2 (appendices)
note: Pretraining corpus includes load and energy sets: GEFCom 2012, 2014 and 2017 load, Australian electricity demand, Spanish energy and weather, London smart meters, BDG-2, Buildings-900K. PJM or EIA not named in the part read. No data cutoff stated. Says only the training portion of GIFT-Eval is used. Benchmark horizons not listed. No licence stated.

title: paris-noah/Tabby model card
note: Checkpoint = frozen Tabby-Pretrain backbone plus a 160-token prompt, 146.7M parameters, licence CC BY-NC 4.0. Forecasts each variate separately, no covariate input, 99 quantiles, history up to 8,024 points at H=168. GIFT-Eval, Seasonal-Naive-normalised, 97 configs: Tabby-Pretrain zero-shot MASE 0.7040, CRPS 0.4827; Tabby with prompt MASE 0.6880, CRPS 0.4758.

title: paris-noah/Tabby model card (leakage and usage)
note: Card says the prompt was post-trained on GIFT-Eval training tasks and the leaderboard submission is marked as having test-data leakage. Loaded through transformers AutoModel with trust_remote_code=True; predict(history, prediction_length) returns quantiles. Links the arXiv report, the TabbyTSFM code and a separate Tabby-Pretrain backbone repository.

title: Hugging Face API record for paris-noah/Tabby
note: Repository created 2026-09-10, last modified 2026-11-06, head sha 6c6034321b3c811e24c8729fb6e274dded68fa31. Tagged cc-by-nc-4.0, time-series-forecasting, custom_code. Files include model.safetensors and custom modelling code.

title: History of model.safetensors in paris-noah/Tabby
note: Two commits touched the weights file: a5d67fc072b4230100582038d8b99b62fb6f121a on Sep 10 (first upload) and 3e5659550ef7faf0343fcd4802877fd511aee78f on Sep 28 (last change). The page shows no year; the API gives the repository creation as 2026-09-10, so both are 2026. Later commits are README edits.

title: FoundationForecast PR 76: add Tabby foundation model
note: Merged 2026-10-26 (commit cb63ddc). Wraps paris-noah/Tabby via AutoModel with trust_remote_code; univariate, no exogenous support. Registers it in a GIFT-Eval harness against the official entry (MASE 0.688, CRPS 0.4758, as on the card); no rerun numbers of its own shown. Default path is bf16 autocast on CUDA; no CPU timing. Both leaderboard entries are leakage-flagged.
